plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing plan with a build focus on general strength and power. Week 1 establishes a baseline for the main lower-body lift so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work starts in Week 2. With only one 30-minute S&C session each week, the plan keeps the highest-value work first, trims accessory volume, and uses crisp explosive work without creating extra fatigue that would interfere with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force and simple explosive qualities with beginner-friendly exercises that fit around boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly harder loading while keeping the weekly dose compact and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place while shifting more emphasis toward fast, sharp power output that supports boxing.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and land softly. Step down each rep and keep every jump fast and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no safe box setup is available. Reset between reps and jump for height.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and keep the dip shallow so speed stays high.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace, stay balanced through the whole foot, and stop if technique breaks. This is a baseline test day, not a grind through multiple work sets.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 reps with strong form. Log the load and reps so the app can set your future training percentages.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if barbell back squat setup feels unsafe or too technical. Work up to one hard set of 5 reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and more comfortable on the shoulders. Same testing approach.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull hard, pause briefly at the top, and keep the chest glued to the pad. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral or close grip and keep the torso still.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench for support and match reps on both sides.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall, keep the ribs down, and hold a load that challenges posture without slowing you down.

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if dumbbells are limited. Same distance and posture focus.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use one side at a time for more anti-rotation demand. Walk 20 m per side.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use the same low box if landings stay quiet and sharp. Stop the set if jump height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Reset between reps and jump with full intent.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep it light and explosive with no pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Move each rep with control on the way down and drive up hard. Rest enough to keep technique consistent.

performanceTarget.prompt: Aim for the cleanest, fastest set at the prescribed load. If all sets feel easy and crisp, note that for next week's adjustment.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if available and more comfortable while keeping the same loading pattern.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if barbell squatting is not yet safe. Choose a load that makes 5 hard but clean.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbows back and control the lowering phase. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the torso quiet and finish with the shoulder blades.

substitutionOptions.name: T-Bar Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use chest support if possible and avoid jerking the weight.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Keep the ribs tucked and only roll as far as you can without losing trunk position.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use small plates and shorten range if needed.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if rollouts are too difficult. Keep the trunk doing the work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Stay springy and sharp. Keep box height conservative so the jump stays explosive instead of turning into a tuck.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if fatigue is high from boxing and you want the simplest fast jump option.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and focus on a violent takeoff.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard before every rep and keep bar speed honest. If the last set slows badly, cut the load slightly and finish clean.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the strongest clean set at this load. The goal is better bar speed and cleaner reps, not grinding.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if it lets you squat harder with better positions.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if barbell squatting is still not ready. Increase load while keeping technique tight.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Use a stable bench support, pull toward the hip, and keep the torso from twisting. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler setup with less trunk involvement.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if dumbbells are limited or setup is crowded.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Carry heavy but stay tall and steady. Short quick steps are fine as long as posture stays strong.

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you can load it quickly and walk safely.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use one side at a time for 25 m per side if you want more anti-rotation work.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Keep the jumps crisp and leave plenty in the tank. This week is for freshness and quality.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want the simplest low-fatigue option.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and keep takeoff speed high.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Deload week. Keep positions clean and finish feeling better than you started.

performanceTarget.prompt: Use this week to own the load with smooth reps and good speed. Note if recovery feels better by the end of the session.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if it feels more comfortable while keeping the same deload intent.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if barbell work is still too unstable. Keep the effort moderate and technique clean.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Smooth pulls, no body English, and stop well before form slips. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a controlled tempo and full range.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bench support and keep both sides even.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis and keep the hips quiet. Use a load you can control cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a harder trunk option and can keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Weighted Sit-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a small plate and keep the motion smooth.
